programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har ständigt "drömmar" som hennes man Joe är fast besluten att motbevisa. Som en drastisk åtgärd skickar han hennes "drömmar" till olika brottsbekämpande myndigheter.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Åklagaren i Phoenix ringer till Allison för att be om hennes hjälp med att välja ut en jury. Han behöver en jury som med säkerhet kommer att ge ett skyldigt utslag och utdöma dödsstraff.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison varnar åklagaren Devalos för att ett av hans vittnen ger falsk information till polisens tecknare. Samtidigt får Bridgette, hennes mellandotter, en ny "lekkamrat"...

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison är frustrerad när Joe genomgår ett medicinskt ingrepp och hon inte kan "se" något om hans hälsa eller framtid. Hon tar hjälp av Catherine, en annan synsk person, som varnar henne.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har en fruktansvärd dröm om att en av hennes döttrar har kidnappats och mördats. Hon blir traumatiserad när hon stöter på mördaren från drömmen på åklagarmyndighetens kontor.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison fortsätter att drömma om en flicka som kastar sig från en klippa ner i en ravin. Till slut ger sig Allison ut för att hitta denna flicka, som visar sig vara någon som dejtade en försvarsadvokats son.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons bror är värvad i USA:s armé och Allison blir skakad till grunden och känslomässigt dränerad när hon drömmer om hans död.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Ariel har drömmar om en ung flicka som försvunnit. I hennes drömmar är flickan tillsammans med ett "träsktroll" som håller henne mot hennes vilja.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: När Allison vänder sig till en professor som påstår sig kunna tala med de döda får hon mer än hon räknat med. En dröm om två pojkar som tävlar parallellt med ett tåg avslöjar sanningen om professorn.
programme.sub-title: The Other Side Of The Tracks

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Medan Allison är sjuk och vilar, tar hennes sjukdom överhanden och hon slumrar in. Medan hon drömmer tas hon med in i världen bakom kulisserna till det tv-program hon tittade på.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: En knarkkung avrättas för sina brott och Allison är på plats för att bevittna avrättningen. Efter avrättningen kallas Allison till platsen för ett mord där vittnena svär på att det är knarkkungens spöke som är mördaren.
programme.sub-title: A Priest, a Doctor and a Medium Walk into an Execution Chamber

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison får en vision av sin gamla bekant kapten Push från Texas Rangers, i samband med ett mord. Hon ber om hans hjälp för att hitta en seriemördare som skär ut sina offers hjärtan.
programme.sub-title: When Push Comes to Shove: Part 1

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Medan kapten Push befinner sig mellan liv och död kämpar Allison med att tyda förvirrande meddelanden från andra sidan i ett försök att stoppa en seriemördare innan han skördar nästa offer.
programme.sub-title: When Push Comes to Shove: Part 2

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Alla ljud utifrån drunknar när en populär sång ständigt spelas mycket högt, och bara i Allisons huvud. Låten ger Allison ledtrådar till var en försvunnen student befinner sig.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer att hon är en kvinna som har blivit inlagd på ett mentalsjukhus 1959. Allison upptäcker sedan att kvinnan från hennes dröm hade gjort anspråk på att vara Allison DuBois, som lever år 2005.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allisons nya vana att gå i sömnen gör att hon hamnar i farliga situationer. Detta gör henne utmattad medan hon skyndar sig att lösa ett kidnappningsfall innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison drömmer om en gammal vän från gymnasiet och bestämmer sig för att hitta henne. Samtidigt ber en man om distriktsåklagarens hjälp för att hitta sin dotter som varit försvunnen i en vecka.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison hjälper distriktsåklagaren att sätta dit en mördare vars advokat också använder sig av ett medium och försöker samtidigt förhindra en skottlossning på distriktsåklagarens kontor.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Following the trail of the mass grave, Freddie & Kate uncover an epic secret & find themselves trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the more reclusive & dangerous Lords of the Night.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge & walk away with the score of a lifetime. Freddie & Kate find themselves facing an unexpected foe after Malvado's attack.
programme.sub-title: Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: As the pieces of the big job fall into place, the uneasy trust between brothers and partners crumbles in the light of betrayals and new loyalties.
programme.sub-title: The Last Temptation of Richard Gecko

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santanico confronts Malvado with Seth's help, while Richie and Kate must stop Carlos and Scott from overturning the ancient prophecy and taking control of a powerful evil.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth and Santanico clash with Richie over his betrayal, while Carlos and Scott aim to take Malvado's empire and unleash culebra frenzy on the world.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: After the Lords demote Seth and Richie to collectors, their organization is infiltrated by a mysterious new enemy bent on destroying the Geckos, the Lords, and all culebras.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Season three of "From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series" continues the Gecko brothers' saga as they fight their way through the chilling world of culebras, the vampire-snake hybrids that control hidden empires in Texas and Mexico.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh

programme.desc: Exploring a once secret underground train factory built inside a mountain during Cold War China, later declassified, abandoned in 2008 and frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Exploring a secret military underground train workshop

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: We explore an abandoned hospital opened in the early 1800s, soon to be demolished after the city went bankrupt and shut it down.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Biohazard Hospital - Humans Left behind

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Explore a recently abandoned high school before demolition, with preserved classrooms, theater, gym, and student items left behind.
programme.sub-title: The Richest Abandoned High School In USA

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Killer Klowns From Outer Space
programme.desc: One-of-a-kind alien invasion sci-fi featuring blood drinking alien clowns harvesting a small city.

programme.title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
programme.desc: In this classic adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel, a demented doctor (Burt Lancaster) spends years on a desolate tropical island working on a drug that will effectively alter animals into humans. Michael York and Barbara Carrera also star!

programme.title: The Tomb Of Ligeia
programme.desc: Vincent Price is a man haunted by his past. In this case, the past comes in the form of his now-deceased first wife Ligeia, who casts a shadow over an ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns in the form of a black cat.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A beloved teacher is stabbed to death in her own classroom by a 15-year-old student who warned classmates about his plan. No one believed him. A solved true crime case that is shocking, deeply disturbing, and a devastating loss for an entire community.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Teen TRICKED Her Kidnapper and ESCAPED Captivity! The Incredible Survival of Abby Hernandez

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In June 1984, 15-year-old cheerleader Kirsten Costas was lured out and stabbed five times by jealous classmate Bernadette Protti in Orinda, California. The case inspired the TV movie Death of a Cheerleader.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.
programme.sub-title: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.
programme.sub-title: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.
programme.sub-title: Her EVIL Lies Ruined COUNTLESS Lives: The Horrific Crimes of Eleanor Williams

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe went on a Tinder date and never came home. The investigation uncovered a calculated murder planned by two predators. A solved true crime case that will stay with you.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Alice Ruggles was stalked and murdered by her obsessive ex-boyfriend after the system failed to protect her. Her family now fights to make sure it doesn't happen again. A solved true crime case everyone needs to hear.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Horrific Murder of Alice Ruggles

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Tragic Case of Mengqi Ji

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Suzanne Eaton, a renowned American scientist, vanished while jogging on the Greek island of Crete. The investigation into her murder uncovered a killer hiding in plain sight. A solved true crime case you won't forget.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Devastating Murder of Suzanne Eaton // Murdered While on a Run

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.
programme.sub-title: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.
programme.sub-title: US Coast Guard Confessed to Smothering her Baby, but the Case Fell Apart

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.
programme.sub-title: She PREDICTED Her Own Murder: The TERRIFYING Killing of Ashley Dale that Lead to MULTIPLE Arrests

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED? The Tragic Murder of Amanda Blackburn // WAS IT REALLY HER HUSBAND?!

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Är det ostvecka på hotellet? Dags för lederhosen och dirndl när gästerna hamnat i Alperna. Ett välbekant ansikte checkar in, redo att ge allt och bara tänka på sig själv.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av killarna lägger näsan i… smink, och frågan är hur det kommer påverka spelet för hans del framöver. Ytterligare ett känt ansikte gör entré, redo att hämnas på sina motståndare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellets after ski bjuder på både bråk och kaos. Svartsjukan bubblar över för ett av paren och den stela stämningen sprider sig på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En kille ska checka ut men, planer smids bakom stängda dörrar och allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Säsongens första parceremoni går till historien och efterspelet är inte nådigt. Allianser börja sakta men säkert luckras upp och hur pakterna kommer se ut framöver är högst oklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En överraskande eliminering skakar om husen. Paren dyker djupare in i experimentet. Vissa partners inser att de kommer allt längre från varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny överraskning skakar om båda villorna. Great och Nafeesah fördjupar sin relation, medan Hall drar en slutsats som förändrar allt. Marisela hittar tillbaka till sig själv när skulden börjar hinna ikapp Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Temptation Light är en ständig påminnelse att det inte finns några hemligheter på ön och att alla aktioner har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det är dags för videomeddelanden, och Mark avslöjar ännu en twist. Även singlarna får nu skicka videomeddelanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren hanterar efterspelet efter videomeddelandena. Nya relationer växer sig starkare och blir intimare. Andra deltagare kämpar med skuldkänslor och osäkerheten på hur allt ska sluta.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren beger sig på övernattningsdejter med deras favoritsinglar. Nya romanser blossar upp, kärleksförklaringar och framtidsplaner görs upp. En till person ger efter för frestelsen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren Marisela & Christopher och Vanessa & Robert återförenas för deras sista Lägereld. Var deras relationer tillräckligt starka för att överleva Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall och Paris & Great återförenas för sin sista Lägereld. Lägereldarna är bra på att reda ut saker och avslöja sanningar, även när sanningen har varit en lögn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren och singlarna har återförenas under 90-minuter för att se tillbaka på sin tid på ön.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En timme av material som aldrig tidigare visats.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fyra par beger sig till Temptation Island för att se om de är menade för varandra.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlarna flyttar in och det börjar gå vilt till. Vid den första Lägerelden uppstår smärtsamma uppvaknanden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Några par börjar njuta av sin nyfunna självständighet, medan andra är fast i det förflutna.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spänningarna ökar i villorna. Linjerna suddas ut vid kvällens temafest.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark levererar en oväntad twist vid utslagningen, vilket skakar om båda villorna.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Känslorna är stora efter den mest dramatiska Lägerelden så här långt. Överraskningsgäster anländer för att röra upp än mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren skickar videomeddelanden till sina partners medan deras band till singlarna blir allt starkare.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Skakade av videomeddelandena, och avsaknaden av dem, ställs paren inför nya osäkerheter.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren går in i deras sista övernattningsdejter. När nya relationer lockar sätts den gamla kärleken på prov.
